newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: World Bank mulls $300 mln in loans for El Salvador.
newsitem.headline: World Bank mulls $300 mln in loans for El Salvador.

text.p: The World Bank is considering some $300 million in loans over the next few years for several development projects in El Salvador, a World Bank official said on Wednesday.

"We have a three-year strategy for El Salvador and we hope to have it in place by the end of this year, to be approved in February or March, 1997 by the bank's executive council," said Sally Zeijlon, a member of the World Bank's Central America area.

She said the loans would be used for several projects, including the development of a plan for privatization of state-owned infrastructure and the legal framework for attracting foreign direct investment. There is another study for modernizing the country's outdated agriculture sector.
Zeijlon said that before the loans are approved, the World Bank will need to review El Salvador's economic policies.
